question: During the freedom struggle, who was the only President of Indian National Congress who resigned from the presidency even after being elected?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose **was elected as the President of Indian National Congress (INC) in 1939.
 
• Later on he resigned from the post after disagreement with Gandhi and Congress leaders.
 
• **Rajendra Prasad **was appointed as the new president of INC after the resignation of Subhash Chandra Bose.
 
• Under the Presidency of Subhash Chandra Bose in the Haripura session in 1938, the INC set up a National Planning Committee.
